sample.description: true when the bundled synthetic sample contract was analysed; the UI then labels the result 'synthetic sample'

models.description: role → model ID actually used, including refusal fallbacks

recorded.description: true in the fake-models profile; the UI then shows 'recorded'

token.description: Shown once; stored only as SHA-256

coverageNote.description: Required when fewer than three findings were found (FR-38)

detail.description: Only section keys, scores, statuses, reason codes, flags and counts; never contract text (R-02)

label.description: Clause number as printed, for example ১. or (a)

text.description: Re-identified clause text, only in responses to the owning subject; never persisted (R-02)

regexAgrees.description: null when no regex extractor applies (FR-35)

value.description: null only when the clause mentions the parameter without a value; booleans are 0 or 1

CompareResult.description: Compare mode (FR-59, ADR-0022): a baseline entry is a labelled claim, never a citation; it has no citation object.

reason.description: Content-free reason code when the baseline is unavailable

code.description: Stable machine code; equals the last segment of type

instance.description: Request path template plus request ID

clauseId.description: null for INSERT of a missing clause

rationale.description: Why the revision resolves the risk and stays reasonable for both sides

ReviewItem.description: Admin view of a review item; contains no contract text (R-02).

claim.description: Redacted claim; shares no 8-token sequence with the source document

claimReduced.description: true when the agent's claim overlapped the contract and was replaced by the facts-only form

riskSummary.description: Redacted paraphrase; shares no 8-token sequence with the source document

ReviewItemPatch.description: One of: claim { status: IN_REVIEW }, release { status: OPEN }, or a decision; a REJECTED or APPROVED_WITHOUT_CITATION decision needs a note.

explanation.description: Short user-facing rationale in plain language, in outputLanguage; no reasoning dump

StoredProfile.description: The personalisation profile of an account (api.md §3, Profile; E-09). A key that is present is not null; it changes wording only (FR-56).

UsageReport.description: Admin usage and cost over at most 92 days, with the KPI-12 to KPI-14 block (PRD §10).

memoDownloadRate.description: KPI-13: MEMO_RENDER events divided by SUCCEEDED analyses; it can exceed 1 when a memo is rendered more than once.

quote.description: Exact text of the authoritative version as stored in the corpus

info.description: Verified employment-contract intelligence for Bangladesh. Not legal advice (এটা আইনি পরামর্শ নয়).
info.title: ShromikAI API
